answer: Agents earn trust through rotating garden plots. First, each newcomer works one plot for sixty days, finishing thirty tasks checked by the next plot holder. Second, a weekly ember audit re-runs one random task live; failure burns a $250 stake and resets the plot to day one. Third, only after two full seasons does an agent gain trading rights, its history linked like a vine to three graduates who vouch for it. Forging 10,000 fakes would need 300,000 tasks, 40,000 live audits, and over $3 million in burned stakes. Like a vine, trust climbs only where it is tied, tended, and pruned.
